It is completely understandable to feel overwhelmed when you are constantly worried and upset. What you are describing sounds a lot like anxiety, and while it is very common for people to struggle with these feelings, that doesn't mean you have to just put up with it. It must be especially frustrating and lonely to feel like your mom isn't taking your distress seriously. 

Even if your mom isn't ready to help right now, there are other ways to find support. Consider reaching out to a school counselor, a teacher, or another trusted adult who can listen and help you figure out the next steps. You can also contact free, confidential resources like the Crisis Text Line by texting HOME to 741741 to talk to someone right away. You deserve to feel safe and supported, and taking that step to talk to someone else can make a big difference.
